verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Jitsu is 100% open-source and deployable on any on-premise infrastructure, with Helm charts for Kubernetes, a zero-config Minikube dev chart, Kubernetes-native production self-hosting in 2.14, and an On Prem pricing tier. A community user also reports easily deploying the open-source version. The one caveat is that a feature-complete deployment requires a Kubernetes cluster; the older HN wish for Helm charts predates their release and does not contradict current docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the current Kubernetes/Helm self-hosted deployment, and a documented lighter non-Kubernetes path with full features.
